title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Choosing the Period Behind an Overdraft Replenishment Amount
content:
A monthly transfer meant to restore what overdraft protection drew from a Savings & Money Market Accounts product is sized on one particular Statement Cycle. This page states how that Statement Cycle is picked out and when it is acceptable.

## Rule

**Start from the last overdraft draw.** Among the withdrawals the account made through the overdraft transfer channel, take the one posted most recently. The Statement Cycle that withdrawal belongs to is the one the amount is sized on.

**Who received it.** That withdrawal serves only if the account on its other side is a Personal Checking account of the same customer. Where it is anything else, no amount is worked out under this policy.

**Ties.** Should overdraft protection transfers to more than one distinct account share that most recent posting date, the ledger cannot place one after the other, and no amount is worked out under this policy.

**Only the running Statement Cycle.** The Statement Cycle so picked must be the one still open today: its closing date is the first one the account's statement closing day yields on or after the current date. If it is an earlier one, no amount is worked out. This is read from the records as a condition of applying the policy; the amount itself does not test it.

## Input, judgement, output

| Most recent overdraft protection transfer | Belongs to | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| to the owner's own checking account | the Statement Cycle now running | that Statement Cycle is used |
| to the owner's own checking account | a Statement Cycle already closed | no amount |
| to an account that is not the owner's checking | the Statement Cycle now running | no amount |
| two on the same latest date, to two different checking accounts | the Statement Cycle now running | no amount |

## Points of judgement

**The owner has two checking accounts protected by the same savings account. Does that matter?** Only on the latest date: if that date shows transfers to both, the Statement Cycle cannot be fixed.
